_comment: Names from the client's character behaviour tree (RDB 1010203/12488 "CharacterBcc" XML, same as 1010501/1 binary, loaded by BCCTree_c::Load); the only states and substates the client defines for player characters, extracted by tools/re/extract_bcc_states.py. groups = inherited action groups (what the character may do in it); about = observed behaviour.

states.name: Idle
states.about: normal: what a player is in when doing nothing special (server BCC_STATE_NORMAL)

states.name: Fighting
states.about: in combat (BehaviorControlCenter::IsFightState is true for it)

states.name: Limbo
states.about: smashed/dead: death effect, the 'You got smashed!' window for a player; only the Limbo action group

states.name: Building
states.about: building a buildable: the client asks for it with BCC command 1 (data 104) and the server sets it, back to 1 when the build stops
